name: Jury Duty
description: The inner workings of an American jury trial through the eyes of one particular juror, Ronald Gladden. Gladden is unaware the entire case is fake, everyone except him is an actor and everything that happens — inside the courtroom and out — is carefully planned.

videos.title: Voir Dire (Exclusive Cast Commentary)
videos.overview: Cast & Director commentary detailing how production was able to create episode 1. Ronald Gladden arrives for jury selection, unaware that an entirely fictional court case has been created just for him.

videos.title: Opening Arguments (Exclusive Cast Commentary)
videos.overview: Cast & Director commentary detailing how production was able to create episode 2. Ronald and other jurors move into their hotel and adjust to sequestered life. In court, the defense struggles with their opening statement and a horrible accident leads to a devastating loss for the jury.

videos.title: Foreperson (Exclusive Cast Commentary)
videos.overview: Cast & Director commentary detailing how production was able to create episode 3. The jurors’ eccentric behavior presents a challenge for Ronald as their newly-appointed foreperson. Jeannie urges Noah to find out the truth about his girlfriend Heidi and her mysterious friend Cody.

videos.title: Field Trip (Exclusive Cast Commentary)
videos.overview: Cast & Director commentary detailing how production was able to create episode 4. A suspicious discovery during a surprise field trip to the scene of the incident sheds new light on the case. Later, too much fun during a group night out at Margaritaville leads to consequences for the jurors.

videos.title: Closing Arguments (Exclusive Cast Commentary)
videos.overview: Cast & Director commentary detailing how production was able to create episode 5. Things go from bad to worse for the defendant. Back at the hotel, Ronald helps James audition for the role of a lifetime and the two of them help Noah with his post-Margaritaville personal matters.

videos.title: Ineffective Assistance (Exclusive Cast Commentary)
videos.overview: Cast & Director commentary detailing how production was able to create episode 6. The defense is on the ropes after a series of questionable strategic moves and Ken is in a bind after teaching Ronald to play a Korean board game.

videos.title: Deliberations (Exclusive Cast Commentary)
videos.overview: Cast & Director commentary detailing how production was able to create episode 7. As the foreperson, it’s up to Ronald to lead the jury through deliberations and arrive at a unanimous verdict.

videos.title: The Verdict (Exclusive Cast Commentary)
videos.overview: Cast & Director commentary detailing how production was able to create episode 8. After delivering the verdict, Ronald finds out that another trial was being held in this court and another verdict has been reached.
